instrument.evidence: Peptides eluted from the nano LC column were subsequently ionized into the Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

ionization_type.evidence: The electrospray source was fitted with an emitter tip 10 µm (New Objective, Woburn, MA) and maintained at 1.6 kV electrospray voltage.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: FT-MS analysis on the Q Exactive Plus was carried out at 70,000 resolution and an AGC target of 1 x 106 ions in full MS.
